title: ElectricityPricingRecord
description: Schema contract for residential utility electricity rates collected via Bright Data

utility_id.description: Unique identifier for the utility provider

utility_name.description: Operating utility or electric cooperative name

service_area_counties.description: Counties served by this utility tariff

residential_rate_cents_kwh.description: Current effective residential rate in US Cents per Kilowatt-hour

previous_rate_cents_kwh.description: Rate from 12 months prior for delta calculation

avg_monthly_kwh_consumption.description: Average household monthly kWh usage in service territory

effective_date.description: ISO date string of current rate schedule
